name: shelf-example
description: One set of octane/data contracts and one server, rendered by an Octane page, a React page, and an Octane page hosting a React island, built with Vite or Rspack.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/server/index.ts --outDir dist/server
scripts.test:e2e:vite: pnpm build && OCTANE_EXAMPLE_PREVIEW=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:rspack: pnpm build:rspack && SHELF_BUNDLER=rspack playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
